name: Booster Robotics
summary:
Booster Robotics develops humanoid robots and supporting software for researchers, educators and developers. Founded in 2023, it initially focused on scientific research and education, bringing together robot hardware, operating systems and development tools. Its product portfolio includes the T-series platforms and K1, with robot football and other competitions serving as demanding environments for testing control and autonomy.

The company emphasizes whole-body motion, balance and accessible development workflows. Its relationship with RoboCup and the use of its robots by participating teams support a wider developer ecosystem. The platforms give teams a physical foundation for studying embodied AI without building an entire humanoid from scratch.
